item.title: Where will the tourists go when the glaciers disappear?
item.description: New Zealand’s glaciers are vital water sources and attract hundreds of thousands of tourists, but a new study shows that most could be gone by the end of the century. item.title: Your digital identity is not under New Zealand jurisdiction
item.description: The government stores our most important data on US-owned cloud infrastructure, making it subject to US laws. Software architect Tamawera Owens explains. Before blowing up your whole view of digital identity in New Zealand, let me assure you that you’ve probably done nothing wrong.
